recognize_zh: 皮膚切片真皮內有結節狀淋巴球浸潤（A、B），免疫染色顯示兩種不同分布：一群為邊界清楚的濾泡中心樣聚集（D），另一群染色細胞環繞在淡染的中心周圍（F–H），提示兩種 B 細胞族群並存，符合複合型 SLL 與皮膚濾泡中心淋巴瘤。
features: Nodular and confluent dermal lymphoid infiltrates beneath an uninvolved epidermis at low power (A)
Dense sheets of predominantly small, dark lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm on H&E (B)
Diffuse strong staining of the nodular infiltrate with a B-cell-type marker (C)
Discrete, sharply circumscribed follicle-like aggregates highlighted by one marker at low power (D)
Scattered positive small cells (likely reactive T cells) intermixed with the infiltrate (E)
A second population staining strongly around pale, marker-negative central nodules, creating a rim/mantle-like pattern (F-H)
describe_en: Skin biopsy shows nodular and confluent dermal lymphoid infiltrates sparing the overlying epidermis. At higher power the infiltrate is composed predominantly of small lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm; cytologic detail of centrocytes/centroblasts is limited at this resolution. Immunohistochemistry (markers not labeled in the figure) shows a diffuse B-cell infiltrate, discrete follicle-like aggregates highlighted by one marker, scattered admixed positive small cells, and a separate population staining strongly around marker-negative central nodules, indicating two spatially distinct B-cell populations. Findings are consistent with a composite cutaneous lymphoma, small lymphocytic lymphoma and primary cutaneous follicle center lymphoma, pending correlation with the specific stains (e.g., CD5, CD23, LEF1 versus CD10, BCL6) and clonality studies.

ddx.vs: Shows nodular infiltrates with reactive follicles colonized by CD5-/CD23-/BCL6- marginal zone cells and plasma cells, rather than a CD5+/CD23+/LEF1+ SLL population plus a BCL6+/CD10+ follicle center population.

Contains polyclonal reactive follicles with polarized germinal centers, tingible-body macrophages and a mixed T-cell-rich background, without an aberrant CD5+/CD23+ B-cell population or clonal light-chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Secondary cutaneous involvement by nodal follicular lymphoma
ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical; typically BCL2+ with t(14;18) and requires staging to exclude systemic disease, whereas primary cutaneous follicle center lymphoma is usually BCL2-negative or weak.
Also CD5+ small B cells, but cyclin D1/SOX11 positive and CD23 negative, unlike SLL.

stain: H&E and IHC panel (markers not labeled)
